texts.title: The Motion Thrown Out
texts.body: {self.house}'s motion has been thrown out by the Senate. The clerk reads the tally without expression; the benches that beat it are already talking about something else. {self.name} has the evening to decide what kind of loser to be.

choices.take_it_well: Thank the chamber for its attention.
choices.note_who_voted: Write down every name that voted it down.
choices.buy_the_house_a_round: Stand the chamber a round (3 credits).

texts.title: The Act Falls
texts.body: An Act of the Senate has been thrown out, and the estates that wanted it are reading the tally in every square of {self.house}'s worlds. They will remember who spoke for it and who did not; they are less clear on what {self.name} did.

choices.console_the_estates: Tell the estates it will come again (1 influence).

texts.title: The Closed Exchanges
texts.body: The Senate's embargo stands and the exchanges of the Reach are closed to {self.house}. The factors have stopped calling. A cousin with a ship and a rim port has started.

choices.smuggle: Run goods through a cousin's name.
choices.petition_the_senate: Ask the chamber how long, politely (1 influence).
choices.ride_it_out: Ride it out on stores and pride.

texts.title: The Speaker's Gavel
texts.body: The gavel is {self.name}'s this session and the docket is a list in {self.name}'s hand. Three houses have asked, with varying subtlety, where their business falls on it.

choices.order_of_the_day: Set the order of the day to suit the house (1 influence).
choices.favour_a_friend: Let a friend's motion jump the queue.
choices.fair_dealing: Run the docket in the order it came.

texts.title: The Leader's Table
texts.body: {self.house} leads a bench, and a bench wants leading. The members are at the door with grievances, requests, and a quarrel about who sits nearest the leader at the vote.

choices.a_dinner: Feed the bench at the house's table (4 credits).
choices.the_whip: Remind them, one by one, who leads.
choices.let_them_talk: Let them argue it out and take the sense of the room.

texts.title: The Commons' Feast
texts.body: The commons of {self.house}'s worlds are holding a feast in the house's honour and have sent up an invitation written in a careful hand. The old blood think the head of a house does not eat in the square.

choices.attend: Go down and eat what is put in front of you.
choices.stay_home: Stay home. A {era:senator|lord} does not eat in the square.

texts.title: The Officers' Toast
texts.body: The officers of {self.house}'s fleet have asked {self.name} to the wardroom to drink the house's health. They will also, inevitably, mention hulls.

choices.promise_hulls: Promise the wardroom new hulls, and mean it (5 credits).

texts.title: The Merchants' Gift
texts.body: The factors of {self.house}'s worlds have sent a purse and a letter. The letter is about gratitude. The purse is about six credits. Neither mentions what they will want later.

choices.accept_and_declare: Accept it and enter it in the public ledger (1 influence).

texts.title: The Old Blood's Invitation
texts.body: The old families of {self.house}'s worlds have asked {self.name} to a dinner where the silver is older than the house. It is an honour. It is also, the commons will say, a side.

texts.title: The Press Gang
texts.body: Under {self.house}'s conscription law the levy sergeants have the right to take, and the harvest is in. The villages have sent word, carefully phrased, about who can be spared.

choices.let_the_gang_work: Let the gang take its quota.

texts.title: The Runaway
texts.body: Under {self.house}'s bonded-labour law a dozen quarry hands have broken their bonds and gone into the hills. The quarry master wants riders. The villages want {self.name} to find something better to do.

choices.free_them_publicly: Free them in the square and say why.

texts.title: The Barred Door
texts.body: {self.house} keeps closed doors, and a deputation of townsfolk has been standing at the barred door since dawn with a grievance about water rights. The steward asks whether the law has a side door.

choices.hear_them_privately: Hear them through the side door.
choices.turn_them_away: The doors are closed. Turn them away.

texts.title: The Open Hall
texts.body: {self.house} keeps an open hall, and this morning it is full to the doors: a boundary, a dowry, a well, a dog. Every one of them wants {self.name} and no one else.

texts.title: The Ballot Box
texts.body: Under {self.house}'s open ballot a town has elected its council, and the wrong people have won. The returning officer is loyal and has asked, delicately, how loyal {self.name} wants him to be.

choices.certify_the_result: Certify the result as it fell.

texts.title: The Iron Law Bites
texts.body: Under {self.house}'s iron law three granary thieves have been sentenced to hang, and the sentence is {self.name}'s to confirm. The magistrates want consistency. The square wants mercy. Both are watching.

choices.hang_them: Let the law take its course.
choices.review_the_case: Reopen the case and read the file (1 influence).

texts.title: The Marque Captains
texts.body: The letters of marque {self.house} sanctions as chair have attracted the kind of captain who reads them loosely. One has taken a hull that was, by most accounts, friendly. The prize money is on the table.

texts.title: The Siege Bell
texts.body: A world of {self.house}'s is under siege and the bell has not stopped since dawn. The garrison commander wants to sally; the steward wants the grain locked; the clerk wants a letter sent to the chair.

choices.hoard_the_grain: Lock the granaries for the siege.
choices.appeal_to_the_chair: Send word to the chair, in the Senate's hearing (1 influence).

texts.title: After the Raid
texts.body: Raiders have plundered {self.house}'s shipping and the harbour is counting what is left. The harbour-master has three requests and the courtesy to make only one of them a demand.

choices.rebuild: Pay to rebuild what was burned (5 credits).
choices.post_a_bounty: Post a bounty on the raiders (4 credits).

texts.title: The Lost Province
texts.body: A world has risen and thrown off {self.house}'s banner. The news arrived with the governor, who arrived with very little else. The household is waiting to hear what the house means to do about it.

choices.blame_the_governor: Lay it at the governor's door.

texts.title: The Free March
texts.body: {self.house} rides under the free march's banner — no {era:senator|lord} above it and every {era:senator|lord} against it. The disaffected of the old houses' worlds are drifting in. So are the old houses' letters.

choices.court_the_court: Send the chair compliments and ask nothing (1 influence).
choices.hold_the_lanes: Put the hulls on the lanes.

texts.title: The Isotope Broker
texts.body: A broker has come for {self.house}'s isotopes with a purse and no questions about where they go. The fleet's magazines want them too, and the chair's arsenal pays less and asks more.

choices.sell: Sell to the broker, no questions.
choices.sell_to_the_chair: Sell to the chair's arsenal at the chair's price.

texts.title: The Helium Glut
texts.body: {self.house}'s tanks are full and the exchanges are paying less for helium-3 than they did last year. The steward wants to sell before it falls further; the admiral wants it kept; the officers would simply like some.

choices.sell_cheap: Sell four tanks into the glut.
choices.gift_the_fleet: Give three tanks to the fleet.

texts.title: The Empty Hall
texts.body: A house has passed out of the rolls of the Reach, and its retainers have come to {self.house}'s gate with a cart, a crest they no longer have the right to, and the house's archive in a chest.

choices.take_the_archive: Buy the archive from the last clerk.

texts.title: The Portrait
texts.body: A painter of some reputation has offered to take {self.name}'s likeness for the hall. Four credits and three afternoons. The hall, the painter observes, has a gap.

texts.title: The Comet
texts.body: A comet hangs over {self.house}'s worlds and everyone has an opinion about what it means. The astronomers say nothing. The squares are waiting to be told.

choices.proclaim_an_omen: Proclaim it a sign of the house's favour (1 influence).

texts.title: The Old Retainer
texts.body: The steward's steward, who has served {self.house} since before {self.name} was born, has asked to be let go. He has a cottage in mind. He has also, he mentions, a friend at the capital who owes him a favour.

choices.a_last_task: Give him one last task: the letter to the capital.
